meta.title: Eat Slowly, Leo!
meta.textType: story: a chant with repeated lines

paragraphs: On Sunday, Lily's family had a picnic in the park. Mia, Leo, and Pip came too. The sun was hot, and the grass was green. Mom, the nurse, brought a big basket. There were noodles, sandwiches, and fruit. Pip played with his red ball. "I love noodles with red sauce," said Leo. He ate a big plate of noodles. Then he ate another plate. He made a big, fat sandwich and ate it too. Red sauce was on his shirt, and everyone laughed.

Then Leo stopped laughing. He put his hand on his stomach, and his face looked sad. "What's the matter, Leo?" asked Mia. "My stomach hurts," said Leo. Lily and Mia looked at each other. Mom looked at him. "You ate very quickly," she said. "Lie on your back, and drink some water." Leo lay on the grass on his back. Pip sat next to him and put his nose on Leo's hand.

Lily said, "Let's make a chant for Leo!" She and Mia clapped their hands. "Eat slowly, eat slowly!" "Drink some water, drink some water!" "One, two, three, one, two, three!" Leo laughed and said the chant with them. They said it again and again. After a little while, Leo sat up. "My stomach is OK now," he said. He ate a small apple very slowly. "Eat slowly, eat slowly!" said everyone. Pip brought his red ball, but Leo said, "No, thank you!" Pip said, "Woof!" and Leo smiled.
text.summary: Leo eats too much at a picnic, and his stomach hurts. Lily and Mia make a chant for him, and Mom the nurse helps.
